note: The twelve. `letter` plus `rot`/`flip` is the drawing; `kind` is what src/board.js runs. One kind per glyph and no two alike, so a push carries its direction in its kind rather than in its rotation — the rules never read the drawing. Two glyphs are authored rather than taken from the font: `+` is two bars at the letters' own stem width and cap height, and `.` is a filled dot, the full stop that says nothing follows. Inert is the commonest piece on the board and the only one with no kind. `exit` is how a piece leaves: "beam" fades and lets its beam do the talking, "ghost" swells a black outline of itself out of the cell, "grow" swells the piece itself as it fades. A piece never both beams and ghosts.

glyphs.name: Inert
glyphs.effect: nothing — it matches, its cell goes, and no ability runs

glyphs.name: Pulse
glyphs.effect: advance the line in all four directions by one

glyphs.name: Anchor
glyphs.effect: absorb whatever is shoved in, and stay put

glyphs.name: Push up
glyphs.effect: advance the line above by one

glyphs.name: Push right
glyphs.effect: advance the line to the right by one

glyphs.name: Push down
glyphs.effect: advance the line below by one

glyphs.name: Push left
glyphs.effect: advance the line to the left by one

glyphs.name: Swap orthogonal
glyphs.effect: exchange upper with lower, and left with right

glyphs.name: Swap rising
glyphs.effect: exchange upper right with lower left

glyphs.name: Swap falling
glyphs.effect: exchange upper left with lower right

glyphs.name: Rotate
glyphs.effect: turn the four neighbours one step clockwise

glyphs.name: Rotate reversed
glyphs.effect: turn the four neighbours one step anticlockwise

glyphs.name: Sink
glyphs.effect: draw all four lines inward; its own cell is the sink they fall into
